_about: Cards and rules that are implemented approximately, not like the original. Key = English card name (or 'RULE: ...'). Edit this file, then run tools/list_approximations.py to regenerate docs/APPROXIMATIONS.md. tests/test_approximations.gd checks that every card name here exists.

Metalmorph.gap: The extra ATK when attacking (half of the target's ATK) is missing; only the +300/+300 is in.
Metalmorph.fix: A battle-time ATK bonus on the equipped monster (needs the damage-step window).

Magic Thorn.gap: Also triggers on discards paid as a cost, not only discards caused by Spell/Trap/Effect Monster effects.
Magic Thorn.fix: Tag the discard reason (cost vs effect) and only count effect discards.

Magical Hats.gap: The two decoys are tokens; the original takes 2 non-monster cards out of the Deck.
Magical Hats.fix: Move two Spell/Trap cards from the Deck onto the field as 0/0 monsters, return them afterwards.

Gust.gap: Triggers when any of my Spells is destroyed, not only when the opponent's card effect destroyed it.
Gust.fix: Record who caused a destruction (effect owner) in the destroyed event.

Patrol Robo.gap: No effect at all (the peek at a Set card needs an interface).
Patrol Robo.fix: A 'look at 1 Set card' prompt shown to the player during the Standby Phase.

Red-Moon Baby.gap: The destroyed monster comes back immediately, not at the end of the Battle Phase, and always in Attack Position.
Red-Moon Baby.fix: Queue the revival for the end of the Battle Phase and let the player pick the position.

Spear Cretin.gap: Also triggers if it was face-up without ever being flipped.
Spear Cretin.fix: Remember that the card was flipped (survive the grave transition).

Fairy Box.gap: The coin is tossed without the player calling Heads or Tails.
Fairy Box.fix: A 'call it' prompt before the toss.

Time Wizard.fix: A 'call it' prompt before the toss.

Barrel Dragon.gap: Coins tossed without a call (the original has no call here, so this may be exact).

Goddess of Whim.fix: A 'call it' prompt before the toss.

Jirai Gumo.fix: A 'call it' prompt before the toss.

Gamble.fix: A 'call it' prompt before the toss.

Copycat.gap: Copies the target's current ATK/DEF (with modifiers) instead of the original values.
Copycat.fix: A 'base stats' value that ignores mods and equips.

Insect Queen.gap: The Insect Monster Token appears immediately, not at the end of the turn.
Insect Queen.fix: Create the token in the End Phase.

Aqua Spirit.gap: The Standby Phase position-change effect is missing (only the special summon condition is in).
Aqua Spirit.fix: A trigger on the opponent's Standby Phase that lets the owner change one face-up monster's position.

The Rock Spirit.gap: The +300 ATK during the opponent's Battle Phase is missing.
The Rock Spirit.fix: A static modifier that depends on the current phase/turn.

Soul of Purity and Light.gap: The -300 ATK to the opponent's monsters during their Battle Phase is missing.
Soul of Purity and Light.fix: A static modifier that depends on the current phase/turn.

Spirit of Flames.gap: The +300 ATK during my Battle Phase is missing.
Spirit of Flames.fix: A static modifier that depends on the current phase/turn.

Dark Necrofear.gap: Only the special summon condition is in; the 'becomes an Equip Card and takes control' effect is missing.
Dark Necrofear.fix: Use become_equip plus a control link when destroyed.

Toon Summoned Skull.gap: The 'attack directly while the opponent controls no Toon monster' rule is missing.
Toon Summoned Skull.fix: Use the direct_vs_attributes style rule with a Toon-monster check.

Toon Mermaid.gap: The 'attack directly while the opponent controls no Toon monster' rule is missing.

Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon.gap: The 'attack directly while the opponent controls no Toon monster' rule is missing.

Mage Power.gap: Counts the Spell/Trap Cards in the Spell zone only (not a face-up Field Spell).
Mage Power.fix: Include the field spell zone in the count.

Mask of Dispel.gap: The card is only destroyed at the next Standby Phase after the selected Spell leaves the field.
Mask of Dispel.fix: A trigger on the selected card leaving the field.

Lightforce Sword.gap: The return turn (opponent's 4th turn) is computed as 7 turns later; not checked against the original.
Lightforce Sword.fix: Verify the turn count with the original and add a test.

Cyber Jar.gap: Summon positions and the order in which the two players pick up cards are simplified.
Cyber Jar.fix: Check the original's order and which player's monsters are summoned first.

Morphing Jar #2.gap: The card count each player picks up is an interpretation of an ambiguous card text.

Exchange.gap: The hands are not shown to both players.

Last Will.gap: Implemented as a continuous effect for the turn; needs checking against the original timing.

Dream Clown.gap: Only triggers when the player changes its position, not when an effect does.
Dream Clown.fix: Fire position_changed from force_position too (with a flag for effect-caused changes).

Sinister Serpent.gap: Returning to the hand is automatic instead of optional.

Jam Breeding Machine.gap: The restriction on summoning/special summoning monsters is missing; only the Slime Tokens are in.
Jam Breeding Machine.fix: Static rules for summon/flip/special summon limited to the controller.

Scapegoat.gap: The 'no summons this turn' rule blocks Normal Summons/Sets only, not Flip or Special Summons.
Scapegoat.fix: Use a rule that also covers flip and special summons.

Ground Collapse.gap: Only zones on the opponent's side can be blocked, and an occupied choice moves to the next free zone automatically.
Ground Collapse.fix: A zone-picker UI for either side.

Destiny Board.gap: The Spirit Message cards can still be played or Set by hand; only the board places them properly.
Destiny Board.fix: Forbid playing/Setting the Spirit Message cards manually.

Earthshaker.gap: The opponent's choice is labelled 'First/Second' instead of showing the two attributes.
Earthshaker.fix: Pass the chosen attribute names into the choice labels.

DNA Surgery.gap: Monster Type icons in the interface do not change.
DNA Surgery.fix: Use Duel.race_of in the card detail panel.

Valkyrion the Magna Warrior.gap: Only the summon condition is in; the rest of the card text has not been read for details.
Valkyrion the Magna Warrior.fix: Check the full original text and effects.

Alligator's Sword Dragon.gap: Face-down opposing monsters count as their real attribute when deciding if a direct attack is allowed.
Alligator's Sword Dragon.fix: Check what the original does with face-down monsters.

Polymerization.gap: 'Goddess with the Third Eye' / 'Versago the Destroyer' can be picked for more than one material slot.
Polymerization.fix: Allow at most one substitute per Fusion.

Fusion Gate.gap: Only used through an effect button; the original may offer it automatically.

Black Illusion Ritual.gap: Relinquished's special effect is missing (it is only a 0/0 monster).
Black Illusion Ritual.fix: Implement Relinquished (equip and take over ATK/DEF).

Relinquished.fix: Implement the equip and stat takeover.

Slate Warrior.gap: The penalty applies to whoever destroys it in battle, including in a mutual destruction.
Slate Warrior.fix: Check the original for mutual destruction.

Shift.gap: Redirects only to my other monsters, and is limited to monster attacks (not Spell/Trap targets).
Shift.fix: Add target_declared events for Spell/Trap targeting.

Dark Spirit of the Silent.gap: The new attacker keeps the original target instead of choosing again; its position is flipped quietly.

Wall of Illusion.gap: Sent back to the hand after damage calculation using a flag; edge cases with multiple attackers untested.

The Immortal of Thunder.gap: The -5000 LP also triggers if it was face-up without ever being flipped (e.g. Normal Summoned face-up).
The Immortal of Thunder.fix: Remember that the card was flipped across the grave transition (as for Spear Cretin).

Return of the Doomed.gap: The Spell Card stays face-up on the field until the End Phase instead of going to the Graveyard right away.
Return of the Doomed.fix: A delayed end-of-turn effect that is not tied to a card on the field.

Gilasaurus.gap: The 'treat as Special Summon' choice only marks the card as Special Summoned (the Normal Summon of the turn is still used).
Gilasaurus.fix: Let the summon dialog offer Special Summon, which would not use the Normal Summon.

Respect Play.gap: The card has no effect: the hand reveal is only a display matter and needs an interface.
Respect Play.fix: Show the other player's hand while the card is face-up (board view).

Kotodama.gap: Only the 'later copy is destroyed' rule is in; the 'two copies played at the same time are both destroyed' case is not.
Kotodama.fix: Detect simultaneous summons (Fusion Gate / Cyber Jar) and destroy both.

Big Shield Gardna.gap: The Spell-negation half is missing (face-down, targeted by a Spell). The shift to Attack Position happens when the Battle Phase ends, not right after the Damage Step.
Big Shield Gardna.fix: Spell targets in the chain link, and a post-Damage-Step window.

Solomon's Lawbook.gap: Implemented as 'skip my next draw'; other Standby Phase effects of mine still happen.
Solomon's Lawbook.fix: Skip the whole Standby Phase of my next turn.

Chosen One.gap: The Special Summon position is chosen before the opponent picks, not after.
Chosen One.fix: Ask for the position after the reveal.

Riryoku.gap: The ATK change lasts until the end of the turn (the card text gives no duration).

Infinite Dismissal.gap: Destroys every Level 3 or lower monster summoned (Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned or Set) during the turn, including ones summoned before the trap was activated.
Infinite Dismissal.fix: Only count monsters summoned after the activation.

Mirror Wall.gap: The halving uses the printed ATK plus permanent bonuses, ignoring temporary changes.
Mirror Wall.fix: Apply the halving after all other ATK modifiers.

The Eye of Truth.gap: The hand reveal is missing (interface); only the +1000 LP effect is in.
The Eye of Truth.fix: Show the other player's hand while the card is face-up (board view).

Ceremonial Bell.gap: No effect: the hand reveal is only a display matter and needs an interface.
Ceremonial Bell.fix: Show both hands while the card is face-up (board view).

Garuda the Wind Spirit.gap: The End Phase position change is not optional unless the opponent has no monster; the player must pick a monster when one exists.
Garuda the Wind Spirit.fix: Add a Cancel button to the selection.

De-Fusion.gap: The materials are always Special Summoned in Attack Position, and a Fusion Monster of either side may be selected without checking whose Graveyard holds the materials.
De-Fusion.fix: Ask for the position and use the owner's Graveyard.

The Flute of Summoning Dragon.gap: Needs a free Monster Card Zone for every Dragon; extra ones fail silently.
The Flute of Summoning Dragon.fix: Limit the selection to the number of free zones.

RULE: hand limit 6.gap: The 6-card hand limit is an assumption from the tutorial text.
RULE: hand limit 6.fix: Find it in the original's code.

RULE: three tributes for the Gods.gap: The Egyptian Gods need 3 tributes by assumption.

RULE: only 1 attack restriction on turn.gap: 'No attack on the first turn' follows what you told me; the exact original rule (also for the second player's first turn) is not verified.

RULE: spell speed.gap: Chains follow normal spell-speed rules; the original's response-window rules (who may respond when) are only partly verified.
RULE: spell speed.fix: Finish docs/DUEL_FLOW.md from the original's code.

RULE: windows.gap: 'Continuous card played' (strings 193-195) and the exact order of the 31 announced windows are not all implemented.

RULE: AI.gap: About 60 per-card AI handlers (for cards that had no effects) fall back to 'use if harmless'; battle boosters are approximated.
